baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person plural verb نَجْعَل, the beneficiary phrase لَّهُ, and the dual noun عَيْنَيْنِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making or bringing into being is directed toward the bodily organ of sight, while the dual fixes the endowment as a coordinated pair rather than an abstract faculty.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something into being supplies the deliberate production of the endowment.
The bodily seeing eye identifies the made pair as organs of sight.

changed_reading.before: The question recalls an unspecified benefit given to the person.
changed_reading.after: The question points to an intentionally produced, beneficiary-directed pair of seeing organs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَجْعَل can install a state, and عَيْنَيْنِ names a dual capacity for direct visual encounter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The making is read as equipping the person with a standing condition of eyewitness access: the person is not merely alive but made able to meet what is present face to face.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies the installation of an enduring perceptual condition.
Seeing face to face turns the eyes from anatomy alone into access to manifest encounter.

changed_reading.before: The two eyes are anatomical possessions.
changed_reading.after: The two eyes are an installed capacity to stand in direct, eyewitness relation to what confronts the person.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual عَيْنَيْنِ remains bodily while activating the eye's branch of watchful care and supervision.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can carry a custodial reading in two directions at once: signs of care under which the person was made, and a capacity entrusted to the person for attentive care.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate making keeps the custodial capacity grounded as a created endowment.
The eye of watchful care supplies protection, supervision, and attentive regard as live functions of the pair.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are neutral instruments for receiving images.
changed_reading.after: The eyes also stage a relation of care and custody, ambiguously received by and required from their beneficiary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pair عَيْنَيْنِ activates the eye as a scout or sentinel while remaining attached to the body's literal eyes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The body is configured as a small protected domain whose two eyes go ahead of action, detecting approach, exposure, route, and risk.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a state supplies the body's equipment as a guarded, reconnaissance-capable condition.
The seeing scout makes each eye a forward sentinel serving the embodied person.

changed_reading.before: The eyes register whatever happens to enter view.
changed_reading.after: The two eyes actively reconnoiter the world ahead of the person's movement and choice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The anatomical dual عَيْنَيْنِ also carries the root's image of a springing, visible water-source.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without replacing the bodily sense, the paired eyes become two potential sources from which an inward condition can emerge outward, most concretely through tears.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being supplies the establishment of two embodied sources.
The springing water-eye makes flow and visible emergence latent within the bodily pair.

changed_reading.before: The eyes only take the visible world inward.
changed_reading.after: The eyes can also be twin outward sources through which an inner response becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation language adds measurement and design, while hardship supplies the operating environment; the eyes read as calibrated equipment for strenuous embodied life.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate making supplies the focus endowment that the creation cues recalibrate.
The seeing organs are the concrete equipment placed into the strenuous setting.
Measuring a thing to its proportion contributes calibration rather than accidental anatomy.
Creative origination links the earlier making of the human to the focus making of the eyes.
Struggle and endurance provide the difficult environment in which perceptual equipment must operate.

structural_cues: 90:4 precedes the focus with first-person-plural creation, echoed by first-person-plural making in 90:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, bodily sight, and hardship; I infer that the eyes are equipment calibrated for that condition. A live alternative is that creation, hardship, and eyes are adjacent but functionally independent reminders.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are a generally beneficial anatomical gift.
changed_reading.after: The eyes are deliberately proportioned equipment for finding a way through an arduous human condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's branch naming the human image in the pupil reverses visual direction: the human made with eyes is also a human who appears inside an eye and can be seen by another.

activation_trace.role: Making into being anchors the inversion in the created human body.
Face-to-face seeing supplies the encounter in which seer and seen exchange positions.
The human image in the eye's black pupil places the human literally within the visual organ's lexical image.

structural_cues: The singular human of 90:4 is resumed by the singular beneficiary pronoun in 90:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the human, the pupil-image branch, and direct encounter; I infer a reversal from possessing sight to being visibly present in another's sight. The simpler alternative is that the pupil expression is only an anatomical lexical fossil.

changed_reading.before: The person is the owner and subject of two outward-looking eyes.
changed_reading.after: The person is also an image capable of appearing within another eye, so the gift of sight carries mutual exposure rather than one-way mastery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated supposition culminates immediately before the focus in the claim that no one saw; the made eyes then become evidence carried by the claimant that visibility and accountable perception are already built into human life.

activation_trace.role: The deliberate making makes perceptual accountability constitutive rather than accidental.
Eyewitness presence converts the anatomical pair into a capacity for manifest evidence.
Supposition supplies the mistaken mental model that the focus question interrupts.
Seeing by eye and insight directly activates the focus organs as witnesses.
The branch of exhaustive negation sharpens the person's fantasy that absolutely no observer exists.

structural_cues: 90:7 immediately precedes 90:8 and moves from the verb of seeing to the noun naming two eyes.
90:5 and 90:7 repeat the same interrogative supposition frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mistaken supposition, exhaustive 'no one,' seeing, and made eyes; I infer that the endowed faculty itself rebukes the fantasy of unobservability. A live alternative is that the eyes prove only personal capacity, not an internal witness against the preceding claim.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are evidence of benevolent provision.
changed_reading.after: The eyes are self-carried witnesses that make imagined invisibility morally unstable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior claim of speech and the immediate continuation with tongue and lips place the eyes inside an input-output circuit: perception receives evidence, while articulated speech releases an answer into the social world.

activation_trace.role: The seeing organ supplies the perceptual input side of the circuit.
Voiced saying supplies the claimant's output that can be tested against what is seen.
The tongue as organ of speech supplies the articulating instrument paired with visual intake.
Speech passing from lip to lip makes the circuit interpersonal rather than private.

structural_cues: The eyes of 90:8 are immediately followed by tongue and two lips in 90:9.
The organ sequence follows the spoken wealth-claim of 90:6 and the seeing question of 90:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spoken claim, seeing organs, and speech organs; I infer a directional path from perception through accountable utterance to another hearer. The live alternative is a non-causal catalogue of separate endowments.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are a private sensory possession.
changed_reading.after: The eyes are the intake side of an accountable communicative circuit whose output can become testimony, claim, or counsel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired scouts of the focus are followed by guidance toward two elevated and manifest routes; sight becomes a wayfinding capacity that exposes alternatives before movement.

activation_trace.role: The seeing scout supplies reconnaissance ahead of the chooser's movement.
Direct visual encounter makes the routes manifest rather than merely reported.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth assigns navigational work to the perceptual pair.
Elevation gives the two routes a terrain profile that scouts can survey.
Appearance and clarity make route-disclosure the result of guidance and sight.

structural_cues: The dual عَيْنَيْنِ in 90:8 is followed two ayat later by the dual نَّجْدَيْنِ.
Guidance precedes the later movement verb of entering the obstacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired eyes, two visible uplands, and guidance; I infer that the first pair functions as the reconnaissance interface for the second. The alternative is that the two duals enumerate unrelated gifts and options.

changed_reading.before: The eyes reveal objects in the environment.
changed_reading.after: The paired eyes disclose traversable alternatives and make the person a route-reading agent before choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: An eye-estimation branch inside the verb of plunging meets the difficult raised obstacle and the question of knowledge: vision can size the terrain and knowledge can identify it, but neither performs the crossing.

activation_trace.role: The bodily eye supplies the faculty that estimates the visible challenge.
The scout image makes assessment precede entry into dangerous terrain.
The eye's estimating the measure of a thing directly links visual appraisal to the withheld plunge.
The hard raised obstacle supplies the terrain that sight can inspect but agency must cross.
Knowledge distinguishes understanding what the obstacle is from merely viewing its surface.

structural_cues: 90:10 presents guidance, 90:11 negates the plunge, and 90:12 asks what could make the addressee know the obstacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scouting sight, eye-based estimation, a hard rise, and knowledge; I infer a staged gap from detection to comprehension to action. A live alternative is that the eye-estimation branch is lexical background with no role in the action sequence.

changed_reading.before: Having eyes is equivalent to having guidance.
changed_reading.after: Eyes can survey and size the hard route, but their very adequacy exposes the separate failure to understand and cross it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The watchful and sentinel potentials of the eyes meet a phrase in which the watched or guarded neck is to be freed; visual vigilance becomes ethically ambivalent and must be redirected from policing captivity toward protecting release.

activation_trace.role: Watchful care supplies the protective use of sustained attention.
The sentinel supplies the potentially coercive or liberating practice of surveillance.
Freeing a pledged or captive neck assigns watchfulness the goal of release rather than confinement.
Monitoring and waiting expose the surveillance potential latent in the neck-root.
Guarding supplies the live alternative between guarding a captive and guarding a person's freedom.

structural_cues: The two words of 90:13 juxtapose release with a noun whose root inventory includes watching and guarding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies watchful eyes, release, monitoring, and guarding; I infer a moral reversal in the purpose of vigilance. The alternative is that the monitoring senses of the neck-root do not interact with the literal emancipation phrase.

changed_reading.before: Watchful eyes are unambiguously protective assets.
changed_reading.after: Watchful eyes are a morally directional power: they can police bondage or become attentive guardians of release.

context_deltas.mechanism: Direct and scouting sight is given concrete social targets: exhausting hunger, a child cut off from a caregiver yet near in kinship, and a person abased by poverty against the dust. Seeing changes from intake into diagnosis of another's actionable claim.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face seeing supplies direct encounter with need rather than distant abstraction.
The scout function turns the eyes into detectors of where material and relational deficits lie.
Feeding another supplies the action demanded once bodily lack has been perceived.
Hunger joined with exhaustion gives sight a concrete physiological emergency to recognize.
A child cut off from a caregiver supplies a visible relational absence, not only material lack.
Kinship makes the observed need close enough to carry a particular relational claim.
The abasement of destitution supplies the social condition that attentive eyes must not overlook.
Poverty figured as clinging to dust gives deprivation a low, bodily, spatial visibility.

structural_cues: 90:14-16 move from an act of feeding to two concrete recipients and their conditions.
The paired recipient alternatives follow the paired eyes and the two routes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct sight, detection, feeding, hunger, relational severance, kinship, abasement, and dust-poverty; I infer that perception is the diagnostic first stage of aid. The alternative is that the charitable acts are commanded independently of the earlier eye endowment.

changed_reading.before: The eyes help their owner navigate personal difficulty.
changed_reading.after: The eyes also locate another person's bodily and relational difficulty, converting visibility into an actionable claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two sightlines can yield depth rather than duplication; the context's linking and reciprocal-counsel branches transpose that binocular relation into a community where perspectives are joined and disciplined by patience and mercy.

activation_trace.role: The literal pair of seeing organs supplies two coordinated sightlines.
Direct encounter supplies the shared reality toward which multiple viewpoints are oriented.
Linking one thing to another supplies the integration that turns plurality into depth.
Exchanging counsel among a group makes the integrated viewpoints reciprocal rather than centralized.
Restraint against panic supplies the temporal discipline needed to hold another view in relation to one's own.
Tender mercy supplies the affective orientation governing how joined viewpoints are used.

structural_cues: The focus marks the eyes as a dual, while 90:17 repeats the reciprocal verb تَوَاصَوْا twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two eyes, linking, reciprocal counsel, restraint, and mercy; I supply the binocular-depth analogy and the arrow from joined sightlines to communal discernment. The live alternative is that anatomical pairing and mutual counsel have no shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Two eyes are redundant copies that improve individual seeing.
changed_reading.after: The pair models relational knowledge: depth emerges when distinct views are linked, just as counsel becomes truthful through patient and merciful reciprocity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bilateral eye-pair is reactivated by mirrored companion groups assigned to right and left sides; embodied laterality becomes an orientation device for opposed communal outcomes.

activation_trace.role: The literal two eyes supply a bodily left-right architecture.
Companionship makes the right-side outcome a persisting social location rather than a solitary label.
Repeated companionship mirrors the first group on the opposed side.
The right hand and rightward side supply one pole of the embodied orientation.
The left side supplies the opposed pole completing the lateral field.

structural_cues: 90:18 and 90:19 repeat the same companions construction while changing only the side designation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bilateral organ and mirrored right-left groups; I infer an embodied orientation schema, not one morally fixed eye for each side. The alternative is that bodily duality and final group labels are unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The eyes form a symmetrical pair for a single field of vision.
changed_reading.after: The pair also embodies the capacity to orient within a field that can divide into opposed sides and lasting associations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The made eyes open onto manifest signs, but covering blocks recognition and tight closure converts the final luminous fire into an enclosing medium; failure of sight becomes active refusal rather than lack of equipment.

activation_trace.role: Direct seeing supplies access to what is manifest and therefore the possibility of recognition.
The manifest sign supplies the visible content toward which the endowed eyes are answerable.
Covering supplies an active obstruction laid over what sight could disclose.
Veiling truth specifies that the perceptual failure concerns recognition, not optical absence.
Kindled fire makes the final visible medium painful and inescapably present.
Tightly shutting a door supplies the terminal enclosure that prevents any outward opening.

structural_cues: The final two ayat move from rejection of manifest signs to fire closed over the rejecting group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct sight, visible signs, covering, fire, and tight closure; I infer a trajectory from available recognition through chosen occlusion to enclosure. The alternative is that the final closure is punitive imagery without a retrospective visual mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The eyes guarantee that a person can see.
changed_reading.after: The eyes guarantee only access: visible signs can still be actively covered, and refused openness can terminate in enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax strongly selects bodily eyes and the reward sense of ج ع ل is form-distant; it remains anchored in the exact focus roots and is activated by the nearby claim of piled wealth. Render it only as an economic resonance: the body already contains two present, non-deferred assets, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنَيْنِ activates ready tangible cash or wealth, while نَجْعَل activates an assigned consideration or reward.

activation_trace.role: A stipulated reward or consideration makes the act of making resonate with assigned value.
Present tangible cash turns the two eyes into an image of wealth already in hand.
Acquiring and amassing wealth supplies the economic register against which bodily assets are revalued.
Abundance piled layer upon layer supplies the claimed mass of wealth contrasted with two immediately present assets.

changed_reading.before: The person boasts about wealth spent while the eyes belong to a separate anatomy list.
changed_reading.after: The two eyes briefly resonate as valuable assets already settled in the person's possession, relativizing the boast about dissipated heaps.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant water inventory mapped from the context's seeing root and crosses from springs to tears; it remains valid as an activation because the packet explicitly supplies both the spring sense of ع ي ن and the quenching branch, while hunger and mercy give flow a coherent ethical destination. Render it as a tear-and-compassion undertone, never as the contextual verb's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bodily dual عَيْنَيْنِ remains visible while its springing-water branch permits the eyes to become two sources of outward response.

activation_trace.role: The springing water-eye supplies two visible sources from which response can flow.
The non-dominant quenching branch adds water and relief as a cross-domain activation without replacing the surface verb of seeing.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the suffering that can draw a fluid, affective response from sight.
Tender mercy gives the outward flow an ethical orientation toward relief.

changed_reading.before: Eyes take in the sight of suffering.
changed_reading.after: The paired eyes can become springs through which seeing suffering flows outward as tears, mercy, and movement toward relief.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the leaking hole and object-socket branches are materially distant from ordinary eyes, and the opening-versus-seal polarity is reader-supplied. It remains anchored by the eye-like aperture senses and exact context branches of opening and tight closure. Render it as a spatial reversal: gifted apertures onto the world versus terminal enclosure, not as a claim that عَيْنَيْنِ literally means holes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual eyes activate eye-like holes and sockets as two bodily apertures.

activation_trace.role: The leaking eye-hole supplies a thin opening through which an inside can meet an outside.
The eye-like socket or receptacle gives the bodily pair a material aperture geometry.
Opening what is locked supplies the ethical expansion of aperture into release.
Closing and sealing over something supplies the terminal negation of aperture.
Tight door closure sharpens the final state as an enclosure with no usable opening.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are two organs located in the face.
changed_reading.after: The eyes become gifted apertures onto relation and release, set against the closing image of a world sealed over its inhabitants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the harmful-eye branch is culturally marked and cannot define the ordinary dual noun; it remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and becomes mechanistic beside watching, release, and mercy. Render it as a contained reminder that looking can affect its object, with harmful, policing, protective, and compassionate directions left coexisting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنَيْنِ activates the branch in which an eye does not only receive an image but strikes or affects another.

activation_trace.role: Striking or affecting with the eye supplies an active, potentially harmful force of gaze.
Monitoring supplies the social extension of gaze into sustained power over another.
Release from captivity supplies a constructive direction in which visual power can be reoriented.
Tender mercy supplies the affective alternative to a wounding or objectifying gaze.

changed_reading.before: Eyes passively receive morally neutral visual data.
changed_reading.after: A gaze can act upon another person, so the endowed eyes carry responsibility for whether attention wounds, polices, protects, or has mercy.

strongest_changes: The immediate movement from 'no one saw him' to the made pair of eyes turns anatomy into a self-carried witness against imagined invisibility.
Guidance, two visible uplands, eye-based estimation, the hard rise, and knowledge separate reconnaissance from the still-unperformed crossing.
The eyes join tongue and lips as the perceptual intake of an accountable social circuit rather than a private possession.
Hunger, severed care, kinship, abasement, and dust-poverty make sight diagnostic: seeing another's condition generates an actionable claim.
Manifest signs, active covering, fire, and tight closure revise visual capacity into a drama of offered openness, refused recognition, and enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly folded remote branch images back into the focus dual: a human appears in the pupil, scouts read paired terrain, an eye estimates the obstacle that sight cannot cross, reciprocal counsel resembles joined sightlines, and split-root water imagery keeps a contained tear-and-mercy reading alive.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from seeing to testimony, aid, and release are reader-supplied; the organ and deed sequences can still be read as adjacent enumerations.
The financial, spring, harmful-gaze, and aperture readings are genuine branch activations but remain too form-distant to serve as replacement translations.
The repeated dual and bilateral structures may organize the reading without licensing one-to-one symbolism between individual eyes, routes, or final sides.
The watchful-eye model remains directionally open: the person may be under care, entrusted to care for others, or equipped for coercive surveillance.
